subject: 3T
name: Mittens (cat and man, watercolor portrait sketch)

styleSelection.reason: Light value planes on white paper carry the cat's tabby patches and the man's skin; dry focal details; fine selective closing lines.

3T.human-hair.reason: Curly hair locks are below brush resolution; one connected blue-grey mass, then directional strokes by value.

3T.hair-side.reason: Same curly mass running down the right temple; broken edge into white paper.

families.referenceCue: orange tabby patches on white paper, pale green eyes with slit pupils, dark rim on the right eye
white chest left as paper, orange stripe patches with broken edges down the right side and the leg
curly blue-grey hair mass, flicked broken edge into white
hair down the right temple, dark grey with paper flecks
pale warm sepia skin, near-white forehead, shadow down the left cheek and right jaw, stubble tone round the mouth
brows as dark brown bands, irises tucked under the upper lids, catchlights left white
